name: Ecuador
dossier:
The Ecuador national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the La Tri, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 23 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CONMEBOL to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Altitude-bred and youthful, with a midfield that giants envy.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Ecuador will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group E and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group E. The connection between Moisés Caicedo and Kendry Páez is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Moisés Caicedo - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Ecuador are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Teen prodigy Kendry Páez became one of the youngest scorers in South American qualifying history.
Ecuador boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Round of 16 (2006).
